title.value: Finite time analysis of temporal difference learning with linear function approximation: Tail averaging and regularisation
title.justification: The title clearly outlines the main topic as the finite time analysis of temporal difference learning with linear function approximation and emphasizes the contributions of tail averaging and regularisation.
title.quote: Finite time analysis of temporal difference learning with linear function approximation: Tail averaging and regularisation ^{1}

analysis.description: This paper investigates the finite-time behavior of temporal difference (TD) learning with tail-averaging and a variant that incorporates regularisation. It derives finite-time bounds on the parameter error of the tail-averaged TD iterate using a constant universal step-size, which does not require knowledge of matrix eigenvalues. The paper concludes that regularised TD is beneficial for ill-conditioned features.

type.justification: The paper focuses on deriving theoretical bounds and conducting a finite-time analysis of a learning algorithm rather than performing empirical experiments or studies.
type.quote: Our analysis shows that tail-averaged TD converges at the optimal O (1/t) rate, both in expectation and with high probability.

name.justification: The study and improvements of the Temporal Difference (TD) learning algorithm fall under the domain of Reinforcement Learning, as it involves evaluating decision policies within Markov decision processes.
name.quote: Temporal difference (TD) [21] learning is an efficient and easy to implement stochastic approximation algorithm used for evaluating the long-term performance of a decision policy.

name.justification: The paper extensively discusses TD learning with linear function approximation.
name.quote: Most practical applications have high-dimensional state-spaces making exact computation of the value function infeasible. One solution to overcome this problem is to use a parametric approximation of the value function. In this work, we consider the linear function approximation architecture [22].

name.justification: The paper discusses the TD learning algorithm as a stochastic approximation method used for solving linear systems.
name.quote: Temporal difference (TD) [22] algorithms are a class of stochastic approximation methods used for solving the projected linear system given in (5).

name.justification: The Tail-averaged TD method is introduced to improve over iterate averaging by ensuring the initial error is forgotten exponentially fast.
name.quote: Tail averaged TD: In this variant, the step-size is a function of the discount factor and a bound on the norm of the state features.

is_contributed.justification: The paper introduces Tail-averaged TD as a practical variant for obtaining better convergence properties.
is_contributed.quote: We provide a solution to this problem by establishing a O t ¹ bound on the convergence rate for a variant of TD that incorporates tail-averaging.

is_executed.justification: The study derives theoretical bounds on Tail-averaged TD without any implementation details regarding execution on hardware.
is_executed.quote: We derive finite time bounds on the parameter error of the tail-averaged TD iterate under a step-size choice.

is_compared.justification: The Tail-averaged TD is compared with other TD variants and previous methods in terms of convergence bounds, as shown in tables and discussion.
is_compared.quote: In Table 1 we compare our expectation bounds with existing bounds in the literature.
